title: Rightward Growth Span
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-alphabet multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $a_0$ be a source-alphabet symbol, let $q$ be a state, and let $s$ assign each tape an optional symbol and a Boolean head flag. For any input-head position, output word, integer frontier $z$, and two zipper lists, the simulator started in its right-growth phase with counter $0$ reaches the right-growth phase with counter $k$ after $k$ steps; throughout those steps its work-head position remains between $z$ and $z+k$, inclusive. The final configuration has frontier $z+k$, its left list is the reversed right guard block determined by $s$ (encoded as internal symbols) appended to the original left list, and its right list is the original right list with its first $k$ entries dropped; its input-head position and output are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: decidable equality on the source alphabet
